meta.pos: verb; verb; verb; verb; verb; noun; noun; noun

defs.def: to make or cause sth to make a short sharp sound （使）发出咔哒声，咔哒（或咔嚓）响

ex.s: Some trees make clicking noises when there is not enough water, indicating drought is arriving.
ex.t: 有些树木在没有足够的水时发出咔嗒声，表明干旱即将到来。

defs.def: to choose a particular function or item on a computer screen, etc., by pressing one of the buttons on a mouse or touch pad （用鼠标或在触控板上）点击，单击

ex.s: To obtain the article or chapter, click on the link provided in the email and log into your ILL account.
ex.t: 要获取该文章或章节，请点击邮件中提供的链接并登录你的馆际互借账户。

ex.s: It only takes a blink of the eye – just scan the barcode and click!
ex.t: 它只需要眨一眨眼睛 - 只是扫描条码并点击!

ex.s: *Start your job search by clicking “Jobs” button.

defs.def: to suddenly become clear or understood 突然明白；恍然大悟；茅塞顿开

ex.s: And then all of a sudden it clicks.”
ex.t: 然后突然间，一切就豁然开朗了。

defs.def: to become friends with sb at once; to become popular with sb （与某人）顷刻成为朋友；受（某人）的欢迎
to work well together 配合默契；运作协调
a short sharp sound 短而尖的声音；咔哒（或咔嚓）声

ex.s: The shark closed fast astern and when he hit the fish the old man saw his mouth open and his strange eyes and the clicking chop of the teeth as he drove forward in the meat just above the tail.
ex.t: 鲨鱼在后面快速关闭，当他击中鱼时，老人看到他的嘴张开，他的奇怪的眼睛和牙齿的咔嗒声，他在尾巴上方的肉中向前开去。

defs.def: the act of pressing the button on a computer mouse or touch pad （对计算机鼠标或触控板的）点击，单击

ex.s: This wealth of ways of sharing is a response to our increasing demand for quality goods and services at competitive prices, all delivered at the click of a button.
ex.t: 这种丰富的分享方式是对我们以具有竞争力的价格提供优质商品和服务日益增长的需求的回应，所有这些都只需点击一下按钮即可交付。

defs.def: a speech sound made by pressing the tongue against the top of the mouth or the part of the mouth behind the upper front teeth, then releasing it quickly, causing air to be sucked in. Clicks are found especially in southern African languages. （尤见于非洲南部某些语言的）吸气音

ex.s: Human speech contains more than 2,000 different sounds, from the common “m” and “a” to the rare clicks of some southern African languages.
ex.t: 人类语言包含2000多种不同的声音，从常见的"m"和"a"到某些南部非洲语言中罕见的咔嗒音。
